_comment: Exactly which backend and frontend go into the all-in-one image.
The combined build used to check out backend@main and frontend@main at the
moment it was triggered. That records nothing: the image tag named the two
commit SHAs, but the build could not be repeated, because 'main' had moved.
Two dispatches racing each other produced different images from the same
trigger, and there was no way to rebuild a released image from its tag.
The build now checks out the sha fields below. Rolling back to a released
image and rebuilding that release produce the same software, which is what
makes the rollback documented in the Updating guide mean anything.
ref is provenance for humans. sha is what the build uses.
